investment_settings.subtitle: Portfolio tracking starts off until you enable it here. Optionally store your EODHD API token for market data (see README → #eodhd-api-token).
investment_settings.feature_toggle_help: When off, the portfolio card is hidden and investment actions are disabled. New installs start here off; turn on anytime.
investment_settings.eodhd_help: Used for quotes and symbol search when EODHD is your primary provider. Stored in the local app database.
investment_settings.eodhd_env_override: The server environment variable EODHD_API_TOKEN is set; it overrides the token stored here.
investment_settings.eodhd_token_placeholder_configured: Leave blank to keep the current token; paste a new value to replace it
investment_settings.token_status_configured: A token is saved in the database.
investment_settings.token_status_empty: No token saved in the database (Yahoo-only unless the server sets EODHD_API_TOKEN).
investment_settings.schedule_help: Saves a daily total in the database for optional reporting. The dashboard portfolio value chart is rebuilt from EODHD prices (same logic as each stock’s chart), not from these snapshots.
investment_settings.eodhd_quote_mode_help: Real-time uses the delayed live endpoint; EOD uses the latest daily close (fewer limits, not intraday). Combined modes try one then the other per symbol.
investment_settings.eodhd_quote_mode_eod_then_realtime: EOD first, then real-time if needed
investment_settings.portfolio_chart_fx_help: When checked, the chart uses daily USD/ILS from Frankfurter for each date. When unchecked, today’s USD/ILS spot is applied to every day (simpler, less accurate for long history).
investment_settings.portfolio_chart_fx_historic: Use daily USD/ILS (historic) in portfolio value chart
investment_settings.snapshot_db_help: Stored in table portfolio_history on the server. Clearing does not remove investments or change the EOD-based chart; it only deletes old scheduled or manual snapshot totals.
investment_settings.clear_snapshot_history_confirm: Delete all rows in portfolio snapshot history? This cannot be undone.
